priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The updated merge path now preserves omitted nested derived artifacts before persisting row updates: `mergeTurnRowDerivedState` copies the current `smooth.lowerBandProjection` when the stale incoming turn omits it, and `mergeChunkRowDerivedState` copies current `lowerBand.detailed`/`lowerBand.brief` when the stale incoming chunk omits those artifacts (`src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:218-275`). `writeTurnRows` and `writeChunkRows` persist those merged rows on the production SQLite path (`src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:1626-1728`). New regression tests cover omitted lower-band projection and omitted lower-band chunk artifacts (`tests/thread/sqlite-maintenance-row-level.test.ts:140-188`, `tests/thread/sqlite-maintenance-row-level.test.ts:246-296`). An ad hoc verifier probe for the prior failure shape also passed, preserving both `newer projection text` and `newer detailed artifact text` after stale same-row writes.
